thread.title: Apple's stock drops as Trump's tariffs comments add to investor agita, analyst says

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple's stock drops as Trump's tariffs comments add to investor agita, analyst says
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) slumped 2.1% in premarket trade Tuesday, after President Trump told The Wall Street Journal tariffs could be placed on iPhones (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-stock-falls-after-hours-as-trump-mentions-potential-tariffs-on-iphones-2018-11-26), which are produced in China. Wedbush analyst Daniel Ives said Trump's comments adds to the current "white knuckle" period for Apple, which has been hit with a "litany of bad news" including the pulling of iPhone sales metrics (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/when-the-going-gets-tough-apple-hides-its-numbers-2018-11-01) and data suggesting softer initial demand (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apples-stock-bounces-back-in-face-of-goldmans-lowered-outlook-2018-11-13) for new iPhones. "With [average selling prices] for the iPhone in the $800 range and consumers clearly price sensitive around higher smartphone prices the last thing [CEO Tim] Cook and investors want to see is additional tariffs added to iPhones and impacting demand drivers at this crucial growth juncture for the company," Ives wrote in a note to clients. "While we are taking a wait and see approach around if this talk is more bark than bite from the Trump administration, we could see a negative knee jerk reaction to this latest tariff news in Apple shares that will add to the agita currently around the name." The stock has tumbled 20% over the past three months through Monday, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average has slipped 5.4%.
-Tomi Kilgore; 0719ET
